items.item_text: High school diploma or equivalent certification.
Is around moving machinery: Yes
Is exposed to marked changes in temperature and/or humidity: Yes
Drives motorized equipment: Yes
Dust: Yes
Experience with personnel management, including staffing, hiring, training, disciplinary action, termination, and performance management.
Experience with collective bargaining units.
4 - 7 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Bilingual English & Spanish
Supervises the daily activities of custodial employees. (20% time)
Plans, organizes and directs routine custodial operations. (20% time)
Trains and supervises the custodial staff to maintain an orderly, safe, and efficient cleaning operation. (10% time)
Maintains proper inventory needs and purchase inventory. (10% time)
Responsible for performance management. (10% time)
Supervise building lock up schedules and security of assigned buildings. (5% time)
Requires knowledge in the care and use of power equipment. (5% time)
Enforces safety, hazardous materials and custodial policies and procedures are adhered to by the custodial staff. (5% time)
Maintains scheduling within prescribed budgetary guidelines. (5% time)

Adheres to rules, regulations, and guidance of Cal-OSHA, union contract (SX), and safety data sheets; consulting with upper management and/or HR as necessary. Responsible for payroll management of assigned staff by reviewing, editing, and submitting employee timesheets in accordance with established deadlines. Participates in search committees and assists with making hiring selections of job applicants; selects and hires staff and student workers. (5% time)

Performs cleaning and general maintenance duties as needed; including but not limited to carpet cleaning, picking up of large amounts of water, sanitary cleanups, etc. Conducts specialized cleaning; scrubbing, stripping, and waxing of tile floors; operates buffers, vacuum cleaners and carpet shampooers, and extractors. Reports conditions for items requiring repair or replacement, or of potential safety hazards. Provides operational support to other Facilities Services units as necessary. (5% time)
Valid Driver License
Read/Comprehend: Frequently
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Bend: Occasionally
Sit: Occasionally

Other: Ability to perform physically demanding custodial and general maintenance work as needed. Ability to lift, move, and/or carry materials weighing up to 70 pounds to and from a pickup truck, car, or cart using a hand cart, lift, or dollies. Ability to reach upward while working in confined areas.
Working knowledge in custodial and housekeeping services.

Knowledge of material ordering, material management, developing cost control procedures and inventory controls. Knowledge in cost estimating for custodial services and developing written proposals for services.
Verbal and written communication skills in the English language, active listening, flexibility, critical thinking, multi-task and time management.

Ability to work independently. Skill to review, prioritize, and distribute work orders, routine work, emergency requests, and to schedule the necessary staff, materials, and equipment to accomplish tasks.
Working knowledge of and ability for decision making, reasoning, ability to develop original ideas to solve problems, and perform operations analysis, and quality control analysis.
Working knowledge of online and/or web-based work order systems.
Working knowledge and skill in effective interpersonal and work leadership skills to provide guidance to other personnel.
Basic computer applications skills.
Ability to read, write and perform basic arithmetic calculations.
Ability to ensure that custodial staff provide timely, accurate and appropriate response to routine custodial issues as well as emergency response to more urgent situations.

Ability to effectively communicate quality and service standards, departmental policies, procedures, goals, and expectations to staff. Ability to motivate staff to provide the highest level of service to campus constituents at all times.
Ability to develop and maintain working knowledge in the use and care of power equipment, hazardous materials, bio-hazardous materials and clean room policies and procedures.
Ability to work with diverse populations.
Ability to work in conditions and environments with exposure to strong odors, chemicals, cleaning solvents, paints, raw sewage, blood, and vomit.
Ability to work varied shifts and schedules (early morning, morning, evening or graveyard shifts; weekends and holidays) as needed to accommodate campus needs and/or events.
Ability to operate University vehicles for business and operational needs.
